source_quote:
The `self.swa_cache_layer` attribute is retrieved via `kwargs.get("swa_cache_layer")` but is strictly required by `_get_layer_metadata` (which asserts `self.swa_cache_layer is not None`). Adding an explicit assertion in `__init__` ensures that configuration errors are caught early during initialization rather than failing at runtime during the first forward pass.
The `self.swa_cache_layer` attribute is retrieved via `kwargs.get("swa_cache_layer")` but is strictly required by `_get_layer_metadata`. Adding an explicit assertion in `__init__` ensures that configuration errors are caught early during initialization rather than failing at runtime during the first forward pass.

rule.description: 当类的 `__init__` 通过 `kwargs.get("xxx")` 取值（默认 `None`），但该属性在后续方法中被严格依赖（例如 `_get_layer_metadata` 断言其不为 `None`）时，必须在 `__init__` 中显式添加 `assert xxx is not None`，使配置错误在构造期就暴露而非延迟到运行期。
checkpoints: 检查 `__init__` 中所有 `self.xxx = kwargs.get("xxx")` 的属性
追踪该属性在后续方法中的使用，是否会出现 `assert self.xxx is not None`、`self.xxx.yyy`（属性访问）等强制非空使用
若后续方法依赖其非空，则在 `__init__` 中提前 `assert` 断言
对对称/继承结构的类（如 `AscendDSAImpl` 与 `AscendDSACPImpl`）要同步修改，避免遗漏

antipattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/attention/dsa_v1.py (AscendDSAImpl.__init__)
self.indexer = kwargs.get("indexer")
self.compressor = kwargs.get("compressor")
self.swa_cache_layer = kwargs.get("swa_cache_layer")
# ❌ 没有任何校验，若 kwargs 未传 swa_cache_layer 则为 None
# 后续 _get_layer_metadata 才会抛错（已晚到 forward 阶段）

self.wo_a = kwargs["wo_a"]
self.wo_b = kwargs["wo_b"]

pattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/attention/dsa_v1.py (AscendDSAImpl.__init__)
self.indexer = kwargs.get("indexer")
self.compressor = kwargs.get("compressor")
self.swa_cache_layer = kwargs.get("swa_cache_layer")
assert self.swa_cache_layer is not None   # ✅ 构造期立即抛出明确错误

self.wo_a = kwargs["wo_a"]
self.wo_b = kwargs["wo_b"]
